dedupe_keys.name: taranto valley submarine landslide seismic data

description: A marine geoscience team publishes processed seismic reflection and well information for the offshore Taranto Valley near the Apulian foreland in southern Italy. Mendeley Data lists SEG-Y and CSV products derived from older ViDEPI seismic images and an exploration well, with two versions under one concept DOI. The DataCite registry states CC BY 4.0 and open access, free to obtain. The data can support submarine-slope stability and coastal hazard simulations relevant to ports, pipelines and subsea cables. They are interpreted subsurface evidence, not a time series of active landslide motion. The original profiles were low-quality raster images, and processing or interpretation can introduce positional and stratigraphic uncertainty. Users should check coordinate reference systems, seismic processing, well tie and resolution before building numerical slope models. The dataset is confined to one part of the Ionian Sea and should not stand in for the wider Mediterranean seabed. It relates to data-era5-reanalysis only as a separate atmospheric boundary source for coupled marine studies. No seismic file was downloaded.
